content:
**Concentrated Fire** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

The perk provides bonus damage and accuracy in VATS on subsequent shots, up to 20 stacks (controlled by the game setting iVATSConcentratedFireBonus, form ID `007CF698`). Automatic weapons gain 1%/2%/3% accuracy per hit, while non-automatic weapons gain 4%/8%/12% per hit. Both automatic and non-automatic weapons gain 1%/2%/3% damage per hit.

The effect will be reset upon either exiting VATS or switching enemies, but is not reset if the player targets different limbs on the same enemy.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Focus fire to gain +3% accuracy and damage per shot. | 001D245A | 
| ★★ | 2 | Focus fire to gain +2% accuracy and damage per shot. | 001D2459 | 
| ★ | 1 | Focus fire to gain +1% accuracy and damage per shot. | 0004D890 |
